source_record.claim_boundary: Computed secondary-alcohol/ketone redox hypothesis. Reference borneol chemistry supports the reaction class and exact cofactor bookkeeping, not substrate scope, stereoselectivity, reversibility or activity of a Cannabis enzyme. Oxidation and reduction are two separate required reactions with an exact shared ketone; no direct stereoisomerization edge is created. All other encoded stereochemistry, isotopes and connectivity are retained. Missing target-specific enzyme capability is a testable hypothesis. No CO2 route or coverage gain is claimed before full-input testing.
